doc.name: THE TRIANGLE
doc.title: THE THREE LANTERNS
doc.blurb: The three lanterns of August: Vega, Deneb and Altair, three white first-class stars a hand-span apart, tied by three long lines you can point at from any garden. Between them a faint field, with Albireo, gold beside blue, at the heart. Vega is the eye; the attack is a volley of three.
